titulo: Why is my faucet dripping (and how to fix it)

frases.texto: Why is your faucet dripping, and how do you fix it in five minutes?
One drip a second wastes over three thousand gallons a year.
That's a hundred and eighty showers, lost to one tiny rubber washer.
Inside, that washer squeezes against a seat to hold the water back.
After years of squeezing, it goes hard and flat, and water sneaks past.
So here's the fix. First, shut off the water under the sink, then open the faucet to drain it.
Plug the drain so nothing gets lost, pop off the cap, and unscrew the handle.
Then loosen the big nut with a wrench, and pull out the stem.
Unscrew the old washer, and put on a new one of the same size.
Put it all back, turn the water on slowly, and the drip is gone.
A washer that costs about a dollar just saved you three thousand gallons a year.
Send this to that friend whose faucet won't stop dripping.
